headline: Engineering Manager  |  Software Architecture Lead
summary: Engineering leader with 20+ years of hands-on software delivery and, more recently, direct people and delivery management — including founding and independently running a B2B software consulting practice for over a decade, and currently serving as Director of Software Engineering, directing cross-functional teams for clients across nonprofit, healthcare, and mission-driven organizations. Comfortable in the day-to-day of engineering management: mentoring engineers, owning delivery, running technology-spend and tooling decisions, and staying close enough to the architecture to make credible technical calls alongside the team. Experience spans healthcare, aviation, financial services, telecom, and logistics, working with distributed teams and translating between technical and business stakeholders. Looking for an engineering management role with room to grow into broader director-level scope over time.

Practices: Team leadership, mentorship, and cross-functional delivery across engineering, design, and business stakeholders
Cloud & DevOps: Technology spend audits & cost optimization (30-50% reductions)

highlights: Became the primary technical authority for a non-documented Dynamics 365 system of record on an Azure App Service-hosted n-tier architecture, stabilizing a business-critical integration.
Advised engineering leadership on DevOps pipeline design, security posture, and architecture direction for current deployments and a planned platform replacement.
Introduced TDD and CI/CD discipline to a .NET Core Web API and Angular codebase, reducing regression risk on a system supporting core business operations.
Advised on architecture and identified data-storage inconsistencies ahead of a planned platform replacement for a SQL Server / .NET Core Web API / Angular product.
Joined as an individual contributor and quickly grew into ownership of architecture and design for new applications, within a strict 3-week Agile delivery cadence.
Owned interoperability and deployment planning across multiple load-balanced environments for mission-critical systems.
Supported enterprise identity management systems at scale (30,000+ employees).
Designed an application that increased customer reach by 40% on day one, stabilizing at roughly 60% within a week.
Delivered advanced real-time executive reporting to give leadership rapid feedback on new guidelines.
